headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 28, 2026**
article:
The Texas Rangers secured a 7-3 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Kumar Rocker earning the win after 6.2 innings of work. Joc Pederson led the Mariners' offense with two home runs and four RBIs. The Baltimore Orioles took down the Detroit Tigers 8-5, with Coby Mayo leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Rico Garcia earned the save and also recorded 2 strikeouts in 1 inning of relief.

Multiple players were placed on the injured list, including Casey Schmitt (left knee meniscus tear) and Kerry Carpenter (left foot plantar fasciitis) for the San Francisco Giants and Detroit Tigers, respectively. The Minnesota Twins also placed Cole Sands (right elbow strain) and Mike Paredes (left oblique strain) on the injured list. Other teams affected by injuries include the Kansas City Royals (Beck Way, low back spasms/tightness), Cincinnati Reds (Spencer Steer, right wrist sprain), New York Yankees (Cody Bellinger, left hamstring strain), and Athletics (Shea Langeliers, torn meniscus in right knee).

Several trades and roster movements took place, including the Pittsburgh Pirates acquiring Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The San Diego Padres signed Nu'u Contrades, while the St. Louis Cardinals traded Scott Blewett to the Athletics for cash. The Chicago White Sox acquired José Urquidy from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for Felix Doroteo, and the Boston Red Sox traded Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals for Curtis Mead.
